query_analysis.original_query: We're looking to optimize the design of our pressure leaf filter. What experimental approaches can we use to characterize the filtration performance across different particle size distributions?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify experimental methods to evaluate and optimize the performance of a pressure leaf filter for a range of particle size distributions in order to improve the filter design.

communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Performance data analysis and design feedback loop

clarification_questions: What is the current design of the pressure leaf filter?
What are the specific particle size distributions of interest?
Are there any constraints on the experimental methods that can be used?
